<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The LoL Asian Games 2026 Grand Final will be played between South Korea and Chinese Taipei on October 2. The best-of-5 series starts at 12 pm JST at the Aichi Sky Expo in Tokoname, Japan. South Korea beat Saudi Arabia 2-0 in the semifinals. Chinese Taipei beat Vietnam by the same score. </p><aside class="te-wiki-box" style="margin:22px 0;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid #e3e3e3;border-left:4px solid #FFC61A;background:#f7f8fb;font-size:15px;line-height:1.45"><span style="display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#1D33B4;margin-bottom:4px">TalkEsport Wiki</span><a href="https://www.talkesport.com/wiki/asian-games/2026/" style="font-weight:700;color:#111">Asian Games 2026 Esports: schedule, teams, points table and results →</a></aside>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">LoL Asian Games 2026 Grand Final Teams and Schedule</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">South Korea and Chinese Taipei both won their semifinals on October 1. <p class="wp-block-paragraph">Here are the match details:</p>



<figure class="wp-block-table"><table class="has-fixed-layout"><thead><tr><th>Match Details</th><th>Key Information</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Match</td><td>South Korea vs Chinese Taipei</td></tr><tr><td>Format</td><td>Best-of-5</td></tr><tr><td>Date</td><td>October 2, 2026</td></tr><tr><td>Start time</td><td>12 pm JST and KST (8:30 am IST)</td></tr><tr><td>Venue</td><td>Aichi Sky Expo, Tokoname, Aichi Prefecture</td></tr></tbody></table></figure>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Eight national teams entered the <a href="https://www.talkesport.com/category/news/lol/">League of Legends</a> event. The Games run from September 19 to October 4 across Nagoya and Aichi Prefecture.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">How South Korea and Chinese Taipei Reached the Final</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Chinese Taipei beat Vietnam 2-0 in the first semifinal. They had finished second in Group B with a 2-1 record. They lost to South Korea in the group stage on September 30, but beat Hong Kong and <a href="https://www.talkesport.com/news/lol/india-league-of-legends-asian-games-2026/">India</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">South Korea beat Saudi Arabia 2-0 in the second semifinal. South Korea are the defending champions from the previous Asian Games.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Vietnam and Saudi Arabia both take bronze medals. The event has no bronze medal match, so both semifinal losers get a medal. Vietnam had finished fourth at the previous Games.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Rematch of the Previous Asian Games Final</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The grand final repeats the gold medal match from the Hangzhou Games. Chinese Taipei reached the final for the second time in a row. South Korea won gold at the previous Games.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The group stage meeting between the two teams went to South Korea. Chinese Taipei will look to change that result in the final.</p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Asian Games 2026 LoL Format and Rules</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The tournament had 2 stages:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Group stage:</strong> Two groups of 4 teams played a single round-robin in best-of-1 matches. The top 2 teams from each group advanced.</li>



<li><strong>Knockout stage:</strong> A single-elimination bracket with best-of-3 semifinals and a best-of-5 final.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Matches use the Hard Fearless Draft. Each champion can be picked only once by either team during a series. The event runs on LoL patch 26.18.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Players represent their countries rather than their usual esports organizations.</p>



<h3 id="h-how-to-watch-the-lol-asian-games-2026" class="wp-block-heading">How to Watch the LoL Asian Games 2026</h3>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Asian Games do not use the usual Riot Games streams on YouTube and Twitch. Coverage goes through regional broadcast partners, so the channel depends on your country.</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>India:</strong> Sony Sports Network on TV and <a href="https://www.sonyliv.com/custompage/asian-games-2026-80110870" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">SonyLIV </a>for streaming. Both are paid.</li>



<li><strong>South Korea:</strong> Asian Games SPOTV on <a href="https://chzzk.naver.com/live/d3fd56ef0d10dc742419f54543b1df00" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Chzzk</a>, which requires a Korean VPN outside the country.</li>



<li><strong>United States:</strong> Willow TV on <a href="https://watch.sling.com/1/franchise/45aa81314357d7fcb1d42f41cf831c80/browse" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Sling </a>or Amazon Prime Video.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Check your local Asian Games broadcaster if your country is not listed.</p>

<script id="te-sticky-logo-js">
(function () {
  var tpl = document.getElementById('te-sticky-logo-tpl');
  if (!tpl || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) return;
  var byMenu = true;
  var marks = [];
  document.querySelectorAll('.tdb_header_menu').forEach(function (menu) {
    var row = menu.closest('.tdc-row') || menu.closest('.vc_row') || menu.parentElement;
    if (!row || row.querySelector('.te-sticky-logo')) return;
    if (getComputedStyle(row).position === 'static') row.style.position = 'relative';
    row.appendChild(tpl.content.cloneNode(true));
    marks.push({ row: row, el: row.querySelector('.te-sticky-logo') });
  });
  /* "menu" position: sit 28px to the left of the first item in the bar (the ALL button or the first menu link) */
  function place() {
    if (!byMenu) return;
    marks.forEach(function (m) {
      var first = null;
      m.row.querySelectorAll('.tdm-btn, .tdb-menu > li > a').forEach(function (n) {
        var r = n.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width && (!first || r.left < first.left)) first = r;
      });
      if (!first) return;
      var rr = m.row.getBoundingClientRect();
      m.el.style.left = Math.max(16, first.left - rr.left - m.el.offsetWidth - 28) + 'px';
    });
  }
  var logo = Array.prototype.find.call(document.querySelectorAll('.tdb_header_logo'), function (l) { return l.offsetParent !== null; });
  if (!logo) return;
  new IntersectionObserver(function (e) {
    var gone = !e[0].isIntersecting && e[0].boundingClientRect.top < 0;
    document.body.classList.toggle('te-scrolled', gone);
    marks.forEach(function (m) { m.el.tabIndex = gone ? 0 : -1; });
    if (gone) requestAnimationFrame(place);
  }).observe(logo);
  window.addEventListener('resize', place);
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(place);
})();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
	var tweets = document.querySelectorAll('blockquote.twitter-tweet, blockquote.twitter-video');
	if (!tweets.length) return;
	var loaded = false;
	function load() {
		if (loaded) return;
		loaded = true;
		var s = document.createElement('script');
		s.src = 'https://platform.twitter.com/widgets.js';
		s.async = true;
		document.body.appendChild(s);
	}
	if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) { load(); return; }
	var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
		for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
			if (entries[i].isIntersecting) { io.disconnect(); load(); return; }
		}
	}, { rootMargin: '600px 0px' });
	tweets.forEach(function (t) { io.observe(t); });
})();

    var list = document.querySelectorAll('.tdm-popup-modal');
    for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      var m = list[i], r = m.getBoundingClientRect();

    }

  }

  var tracked = false;
